=== TASK 1 (primary — user request): stop Samsung Internet / Chromium Auto Dark Theme from force-inverting the game's colors ===
The user reports the Samsung browser inverting the game's colors. Root cause: `index.html` declares NO color-scheme, so Chromium's Auto Dark Theme (used by Samsung Internet's 'Dark mode' / 'Darken websites') treats the page as light and force-inverts it. The game is already dark-themed (body background #0f1418), so declare the page dark-color-scheme-aware — the documented opt-out that makes Chromium Auto Dark skip the page:
- In `index.html` <head>, add: `<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark" />` (near the existing theme-color meta).
- In the existing `<style>` block, add `color-scheme: dark;` to the `html, body` rule.
- Add a short HTML/CSS comment explaining this opts the page out of Chromium/Samsung Auto Dark Theme (it declares the page manages its own dark colors), and that it does NOT affect OS-level Android Accessibility 'Color inversion'/'High contrast' (those are user-controlled device settings no website can override).
Do NOT change any actual game/UI colors. Do not touch the analytics comment block.

=== TASK 2 (a11y consistency — from the prior GLM review): enlarge the Results back-to-Menu text button tap target ===
In `src/scenes/ResultsScene.ts` (around lines 78-90), the tertiary '← Menu' TEXT button still uses a bare `.setInteractive({ useHandCursor: true })` (default text-bounds hit area) — about ~26 CSS px tall at typical landscape-phone FIT scale, below the ~44 CSS-px a11y target (spec §10.4). It is the only interactive control the earlier hit-area fix didn't bring up to the floor. Give it a hit area floored to `MIN_TAP_TARGET_PX` (from `src/config/gameConfig.ts`), consistent with the rest of that fix. Preferred approach: generalize the existing `enlargeHitArea` helper in `src/ui/Button.ts` so its parameter type accepts a text object too (widen from `Phaser.GameObjects.Image` to a type that covers both Image and Text — e.g. `Phaser.GameObjects.Components.ComputedSize & Phaser.GameObjects.GameObject`, or whatever keeps `tsc` strict happy) and apply it to the Menu button; OR, if that's awkward, set an explicit centered `Phaser.Geom.Rectangle` on the text object floored to `MIN_TAP_TARGET_PX`. The button's top-left area is empty, so enlarging won't collide with other controls. Keep the visible text/label unchanged. Keep TypeScript strict green.

=== TASK 3 (docs): README deploy note ===
In `README.md`, in the GitHub Pages / deploy section, add the missing one-time prerequisite step BEFORE `npm run deploy`: you must have an `origin` git remote configured, because `gh-pages` publishes by pushing `dist/` to the `gh-pages` branch of `remote.origin.url`. Show: `git remote add origin git@github.com:inn0minatus/HappyDog.git` (or the https form `https://github.com/inn0minatus/HappyDog.git`). Note that without it, deploy fails with `Error: Failed to get remote.origin.url`. Also note the repo name must match the Vite `base` (`/HappyDog/`). Keep it concise and match the existing README style.

1	# Happy Dog Runner
2	
3	A branded, **mobile-first 2D browser runner** — an advergame promoting a dog
4	flea-and-tick tablet. The hero dog auto-runs through a park, jumps obstacles,
5	dodges **ticks**, and collects **tablets**. A finite ~60–90 s level ends in
6	**Victory** (reach the finish line) or **Game Over** (lose all 3 HP), and both
7	results screens surface a single **buy CTA** that carries a promo code and links
8	to [tabletki.ua](https://tabletki.ua). The gameplay is the vehicle; the marketing
9	funnel (`start_game` → `finish_game` → `click_buy`) is the point.
10	
11	> **Status: Phase 5 — launch candidate.** Core run loop, UI/HUD/audio, and the
12	> analytics + CTA + deploy tooling are all in place against final SVG art.
13	
14	## Stack
15	
16	- **Phaser 3** + **TypeScript** (strict) + **Vite**
17	- 100% **static**, **no backend** — ship `dist/` to any static host
18	- Arcade Physics · `Scale.FIT` + `CENTER_BOTH` · fixed logical **1280×720 landscape**
19	- Graphics are **SVG only** (one file per entity/state), loaded via `this.load.svg`
20	- Audio is **synthesized at runtime** into WAV blobs (zero network, fully static-hostable) as placeholder SFX/music
21	
22	## Run
23	
24	```bash
25	npm install
26	npm run dev          # local dev server (Vite)
27	npm run build        # production build → dist/
28	npm run preview      # serve the built dist/ locally
29	npm run typecheck    # tsc --noEmit (strict) — keep green
30	```
31	
32	## Configuration
33	
34	Copy `.env.example` → `.env` (or `.env.local`) and fill per environment. **Every
35	var is optional** — with none set, or with the example placeholders left in, the
36	app builds and runs correctly and **analytics is a safe no-op** (no vendor script
37	loads, no network request, no console error). Resolved in `src/config/env.ts`.
38	
39	| Var | What it is | Client supplies |
40	|---|---|---|
41	| `VITE_GA4_ID` | GA4 Measurement ID (`G-XXXXXXXXXX`). Placeholder/empty → GA4 disabled | Real `G-…` from their GA4 property |
42	| `VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID` | Meta Pixel ID (15-digit numeric). All-zeros/empty → Pixel disabled | Real id from Events Manager |
43	| `VITE_PROMO_CODE` | Promo code shown & copyable on the CTA, also appended to the buy URL as `promo=` | Real code (default `DOG10` is a placeholder) |
44	| `VITE_BUY_URL` | Base buy URL the CTA opens (`promo=` + UTM appended at runtime by `buildBuyUrl()`) | Exact tabletki.ua product page |
45	| `VITE_UTM_SOURCE` | UTM source appended to the buy URL | Per campaign (default `happydogrunner`) |
46	| `VITE_UTM_MEDIUM` | UTM medium appended to the buy URL | Per campaign (default `game`) |
47	| `VITE_UTM_CAMPAIGN` | UTM campaign appended to the buy URL | Per campaign (default `tick_protection`) |
48	| `VITE_DEBUG_ANALYTICS` | `"true"` mirrors every `track()` call to `console.debug` for QA | n/a (default off) |
49	
50	## Analytics
51	
52	All tracking goes through the single `track()` adapter in `src/analytics/track.ts`
53	— game code never calls `gtag`/`fbq` directly. The three funnel events (names are
54	fixed by the brief, do not rename):
55	
56	| Event | Params | Fires from |
57	|---|---|---|
58	| `start_game` | _(none)_ | `GameScene`, once as the run begins |
59	| `finish_game` | `result` (`win`\|`lose`), `score`, `duration_s` (active play, paused time excluded) | `GameScene`, on Victory **or** Game Over |
60	| `click_buy` | `destination`, `promo_code` | `ResultsScene`, when the buy CTA is tapped (then opens the buy URL in a new tab) |
61	
62	Each event is dispatched to **GA4** (`gtag('event', …)`) and **Meta Pixel**
63	(`fbq('trackCustom', …)`) — but **only when a real (non-empty, non-placeholder)
64	ID is configured AND consent is granted** (`setAnalyticsConsent`, defaults to
65	granted). Vendor scripts are injected at runtime by `initAnalytics()` only then;
66	absent/blocked pixels never throw (`typeof`-guarded), so the game is fully
67	playable with ad-blockers on.
68	
69	## Deploy to GitHub Pages (no CI, zero Actions minutes)
70	
71	This repo ships **without any GitHub Actions workflow** — deploy is a **local
72	build + push to the `gh-pages` branch**, served by Pages' built-in
73	"Deploy from a branch" pipeline. That uses **zero Actions minutes**.
74	
75	**One-time setup** (repo → Settings → Pages):
76	- **Source:** `Deploy from a branch`
77	- **Branch:** `gh-pages` / folder: `/` (root)
78	
79	**Then publish:**
80	```bash
81	npm run deploy
82	```
83	This runs `vite build`, then publishes `dist/` to the `gh-pages` branch via the
84	[`gh-pages`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gh-pages) package
85	(`gh-pages -d dist -t`; the `-t`/`--dotfiles` flag ensures `.nojekyll` is pushed).
86	
87	Two things make this work:
88	- `public/.nojekyll` (empty) is copied into the `dist/` root, telling GitHub Pages
89	  to **serve `dist/assets/` without Jekyll processing** (otherwise underscored /
90	  generated asset paths can be dropped).
91	- **Vite `base` is `'/HappyDog/'`** (a project-page sub-path, not `/`). Vite
92	  rewrites the processed asset/script URLs to that prefix, and `PreloadScene`
93	  prefixes the runtime SVG URLs with `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` — so everything
94	  resolves under the sub-path instead of 404-ing at the domain root.
95	
96	**Live URL:** <https://inn0minatus.github.io/HappyDog/>
97	**Repo:** `git@github.com:inn0minatus/HappyDog.git`
98	
99	## Customizing assets
100	
101	**Branded audio** — replace the synthesized placeholders with real files via
102	`scene.load.audio(key, ['x.m4a', 'x.ogg'])` under the **same keys** in
103	`src/systems/audio.ts` (`registerAudio`). Nothing else changes — playback already
104	runs through the shared `scene.sound`, so the persisted mute
105	(`localStorage` `hdr:muted`) and the iOS first-gesture unlock apply automatically.
106	Keys: SFX `sfx_jump`, `sfx_hit`, `sfx_tablet`, `sfx_armor`, `sfx_victory`,
107	`sfx_defeat`, `sfx_ui`; music `music_menu`, `music_game`.
108	
109	**Final art / brand** — art is SVG at `public/assets/<group>/<key>.svg`
110	(groups: `dog`, `env`, `entities`, `vfx`, `ui`, `screens`). The single contract of
111	keys + logical dimensions is `src/config/assetManifest.ts`. Replace files at those
112	exact keys; for any new/edited asset or a re-theme, follow the locked palette &
113	style in `docs/art-direction.md`.
114	
115	> ⚠️ **Do not run `npm run gen:placeholders`** now that final art exists — it
116	> regenerates the Phase-1 greybox from the manifest and **clobbers the finals**.
117	
118	## Still client-dependent (spec §11)
119	
120	These block a firm cost/timeline and must be confirmed before launch:
121	
122	- **Performance KPIs** — proposed budget (§2.3): ≤3 s TTI on 4G, 60 FPS mid-range /
123	  ≥30 FPS floor on low-end, ≤4–6 MB gzipped initial download.
124	- **Final promo code + exact tabletki.ua landing URL** (currently placeholder
125	  `DOG10` and `https://tabletki.ua`).
126	- **GA4 Measurement ID + Meta Pixel ID** (env vars above).
127	- **Brand assets** — logo, colors, product imagery (placeholders until brand kit).
128	- **Environment theme** — park is assumed; the brief offered park / forest / city avenue.
129	- **UI language & i18n** — Ukrainian primary, built i18n-ready (`src/i18n/strings.ts`).
130	
131	## Pre-launch on-device checks
132	
133	These need a **real device** and are **not blockers**, but should be done before
134	launch:
135	
136	- **(a) Visual playtest + `gameConfig` tuning.** Jump feel, hitbox fairness, hazard
137	  density, and parallax all live as constants in `src/config/gameConfig.ts` —
138	  e.g. `HAZARD_SPACING_START`/`HAZARD_SPACING_END`, `COLLECTIBLE_HOVER_PX`,
139	  `HERO_BODY_WIDTH`/`HERO_BODY_HEIGHT`, and the parallax factors
140	  (`PARALLAX_FACTOR_FAR`/`_NEAR`/`_GROUND`/`_GRASS`) — watch the parallax **seam**
141	  between layers on a real screen.
142	- **(b) iOS / mobile audio-unlock.** Web Audio is suspended until the first user
143	  gesture, so **menu music can't autoplay before the first tap — by design.**
144	  Verify silence before the first gesture and correct audio after it; confirm a
145	  muted player who taps Play stays muted.

1	# Happy Dog Runner
2	
3	A branded, **mobile-first 2D browser runner** — an advergame promoting a dog
4	flea-and-tick tablet. The hero dog auto-runs through a park, jumps obstacles,
5	dodges **ticks**, and collects **tablets**. A finite ~60–90 s level ends in
6	**Victory** (reach the finish line) or **Game Over** (lose all 3 HP), and both
7	results screens surface a single **buy CTA** that carries a promo code and links
8	to [tabletki.ua](https://tabletki.ua). The gameplay is the vehicle; the marketing
9	funnel (`start_game` → `finish_game` → `click_buy`) is the point.
10	
11	> **Status: Phase 5 — launch candidate.** Core run loop, UI/HUD/audio, and the
12	> analytics + CTA + deploy tooling are all in place against final SVG art.
13	
14	## Stack
15	
16	- **Phaser 3** + **TypeScript** (strict) + **Vite**
17	- 100% **static**, **no backend** — ship `dist/` to any static host
18	- Arcade Physics · `Scale.FIT` + `CENTER_BOTH` · fixed logical **1280×720 landscape**
19	- Graphics are **SVG only** (one file per entity/state), loaded via `this.load.svg`
20	- Audio is **synthesized at runtime** into WAV blobs (zero network, fully static-hostable) as placeholder SFX/music
21	
22	## Run
23	
24	```bash
25	npm install
26	npm run dev          # local dev server (Vite)
27	npm run build        # production build → dist/
28	npm run preview      # serve the built dist/ locally
29	npm run typecheck    # tsc --noEmit (strict) — keep green
30	```
31	
32	## Configuration
33	
34	Copy `.env.example` → `.env` (or `.env.local`) and fill per environment. **Every
35	var is optional** — with none set, or with the example placeholders left in, the
36	app builds and runs correctly and **analytics is a safe no-op** (no vendor script
37	loads, no network request, no console error). Resolved in `src/config/env.ts`.
38	
39	| Var | What it is | Client supplies |
40	|---|---|---|
41	| `VITE_GA4_ID` | GA4 Measurement ID (`G-XXXXXXXXXX`). Placeholder/empty → GA4 disabled | Real `G-…` from their GA4 property |
42	| `VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID` | Meta Pixel ID (15-digit numeric). All-zeros/empty → Pixel disabled | Real id from Events Manager |
43	| `VITE_PROMO_CODE` | Promo code shown & copyable on the CTA, also appended to the buy URL as `promo=` | Real code (default `DOG10` is a placeholder) |
44	| `VITE_BUY_URL` | Base buy URL the CTA opens (`promo=` + UTM appended at runtime by `buildBuyUrl()`) | Exact tabletki.ua product page |
45	| `VITE_UTM_SOURCE` | UTM source appended to the buy URL | Per campaign (default `happydogrunner`) |
46	| `VITE_UTM_MEDIUM` | UTM medium appended to the buy URL | Per campaign (default `game`) |
47	| `VITE_UTM_CAMPAIGN` | UTM campaign appended to the buy URL | Per campaign (default `tick_protection`) |
48	| `VITE_DEBUG_ANALYTICS` | `"true"` mirrors every `track()` call to `console.debug` for QA | n/a (default off) |
49	
50	## Analytics
51	
52	All tracking goes through the single `track()` adapter in `src/analytics/track.ts`
53	— game code never calls `gtag`/`fbq` directly. The three funnel events (names are
54	fixed by the brief, do not rename):
55	
56	| Event | Params | Fires from |
57	|---|---|---|
58	| `start_game` | _(none)_ | `GameScene`, once as the run begins |
59	| `finish_game` | `result` (`win`\|`lose`), `score`, `duration_s` (active play, paused time excluded) | `GameScene`, on Victory **or** Game Over |
60	| `click_buy` | `destination`, `promo_code` | `ResultsScene`, when the buy CTA is tapped (then opens the buy URL in a new tab) |
61	
62	Each event is dispatched to **GA4** (`gtag('event', …)`) and **Meta Pixel**
63	(`fbq('trackCustom', …)`) — but **only when a real (non-empty, non-placeholder)
64	ID is configured AND consent is granted** (`setAnalyticsConsent`, defaults to
65	granted). Vendor scripts are injected at runtime by `initAnalytics()` only then;
66	absent/blocked pixels never throw (`typeof`-guarded), so the game is fully
67	playable with ad-blockers on.
68	
69	## Deploy to GitHub Pages (no CI, zero Actions minutes)
70	
71	This repo ships **without any GitHub Actions workflow** — deploy is a **local
72	build + push to the `gh-pages` branch**, served by Pages' built-in
73	"Deploy from a branch" pipeline. That uses **zero Actions minutes**.
74	
75	**One-time setup** (repo → Settings → Pages):
76	- **Source:** `Deploy from a branch`
77	- **Branch:** `gh-pages` / folder: `/` (root)
78	
79	**Then publish:**
80	```bash
81	npm run deploy
82	```
83	This runs `vite build`, then publishes `dist/` to the `gh-pages` branch via the
84	[`gh-pages`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gh-pages) package
85	(`gh-pages -d dist -t`; the `-t`/`--dotfiles` flag ensures `.nojekyll` is pushed).
86	
87	Two things make this work:
88	- `public/.nojekyll` (empty) is copied into the `dist/` root, telling GitHub Pages
89	  to **serve `dist/assets/` without Jekyll processing** (otherwise underscored /
90	  generated asset paths can be dropped).
91	- **Vite `base` is `'/HappyDog/'`** (a project-page sub-path, not `/`). Vite
92	  rewrites the processed asset/script URLs to that prefix, and `PreloadScene`
93	  prefixes the runtime SVG URLs with `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` — so everything
94	  resolves under the sub-path instead of 404-ing at the domain root.
95	
96	**Live URL:** <https://inn0minatus.github.io/HappyDog/>
97	**Repo:** `git@github.com:inn0minatus/HappyDog.git`
98	
99	## Customizing assets
100	
101	**Branded audio** — replace the synthesized placeholders with real files via
102	`scene.load.audio(key, ['x.m4a', 'x.ogg'])` under the **same keys** in
103	`src/systems/audio.ts` (`registerAudio`). Nothing else changes — playback already
104	runs through the shared `scene.sound`, so the persisted mute
105	(`localStorage` `hdr:muted`) and the iOS first-gesture unlock apply automatically.
106	Keys: SFX `sfx_jump`, `sfx_hit`, `sfx_tablet`, `sfx_armor`, `sfx_victory`,
107	`sfx_defeat`, `sfx_ui`; music `music_menu`, `music_game`.
108	
109	**Final art / brand** — art is SVG at `public/assets/<group>/<key>.svg`
110	(groups: `dog`, `env`, `entities`, `vfx`, `ui`, `screens`). The single contract of
111	keys + logical dimensions is `src/config/assetManifest.ts`. Replace files at those
112	exact keys; for any new/edited asset or a re-theme, follow the locked palette &
113	style in `docs/art-direction.md`.
114	
115	> ⚠️ **Do not run `npm run gen:placeholders`** now that final art exists — it
116	> regenerates the Phase-1 greybox from the manifest and **clobbers the finals**.
117	
118	## Still client-dependent (spec §11)
119	
120	These block a firm cost/timeline and must be confirmed before launch:
121	
122	- **Performance KPIs** — proposed budget (§2.3): ≤3 s TTI on 4G, 60 FPS mid-range /
123	  ≥30 FPS floor on low-end, ≤4–6 MB gzipped initial download.
124	- **Final promo code + exact tabletki.ua landing URL** (currently placeholder
125	  `DOG10` and `https://tabletki.ua`).
126	- **GA4 Measurement ID + Meta Pixel ID** (env vars above).
127	- **Brand assets** — logo, colors, product imagery (placeholders until brand kit).
128	- **Environment theme** — park is assumed; the brief offered park / forest / city avenue.
129	- **UI language & i18n** — Ukrainian primary, built i18n-ready (`src/i18n/strings.ts`).
130	
131	## Pre-launch on-device checks
132	
133	These need a **real device** and are **not blockers**, but should be done before
134	launch:
135	
136	- **(a) Visual playtest + `gameConfig` tuning.** Jump feel, hitbox fairness, hazard
137	  density, and parallax all live as constants in `src/config/gameConfig.ts` —
138	  e.g. `HAZARD_SPACING_START`/`HAZARD_SPACING_END`, `COLLECTIBLE_HOVER_PX`,
139	  `HERO_BODY_WIDTH`/`HERO_BODY_HEIGHT`, and the parallax factors
140	  (`PARALLAX_FACTOR_FAR`/`_NEAR`/`_GROUND`/`_GRASS`) — watch the parallax **seam**
141	  between layers on a real screen.
142	- **(b) iOS / mobile audio-unlock.** Web Audio is suspended until the first user
143	  gesture, so **menu music can't autoplay before the first tap — by design.**
144	  Verify silence before the first gesture and correct audio after it; confirm a
145	  muted player who taps Play stays muted.
